args:
Please ensure all changes are committed, then We are retiring PAI and moving to plain Claude Code. Goal: every repo in ~/dev must be self-sufficient, so a fresh Claude Code session opened in that repo picks up the project with full context and no PAI. Australian English, no em dashes.

Hard limits for this task: do not modify ~/.claude or anything PAI. Do not delete anything. Do not touch .env or any secrets. Do not push or merge. Work on a branch in each repo.

STEP 0. Find the source context.
The project knowledge lives in the life-os workspace (Markdown: CLAUDE.md, overview.md, ISA.md, context/*.md, agents/*/claude.md and memory.md). Use ~/Documents/workspace if it exists on this machine. Otherwise run `git clone git@github.com:nicholas-wood/life-os.git ~/life-os-import` and treat it as read-only.

STEP 1. Map and stop.
List every git repo under ~/dev (two levels deep). Map each one to its workspace folder. Expected:
- accessbuddy -> projects/accessbuddy
- lifesaveroncall -> projects/lifesaveroncall
- envelope-os / penny (BudgetBuddy) -> projects/envelope-os
- limsoc / brief-poc -> projects/limsoc
- linear-tracking -> lifesaving/lsv/lsv-comms-officer/linear-tracking
- life-os-console -> projects/life-os-console (paused)
- inkwell -> projects/inkwell (design only, may have no repo)
Show me the table, flag repos with no workspace match and workspace projects with no repo, then STOP and wait for my go-ahead.

STEP 2. For each confirmed repo, on a new branch `chore/native-claude-context`:
1. CLAUDE.md: keep anything already in the repo's CLAUDE.md. Merge in the workspace operator brief: what the project is, stack, conventions and every hard rule from past incidents. Remove PAI-specific content: agent-onboarder, represented agents, harness pointers, ~/.claude/PAI paths, Algorithm or ISA tier jargon. Make all paths repo-relative. Keep it under about 150 lines; push detail into docs.
2. docs/context/: copy facts.md, state.md, feedback.md, references.md, overview.md, ISA.md and any other context/*.md that is still accurate. Fix paths that pointed at the workspace.
3. Agent learnings: fold each agents/*/memory.md into docs/context/feedback.md as dated bullets under the agent's role name, de-duplicated. Where a role is genuinely useful (architect, feature-dev, infra-ops, qa-verify, security-redteam), create a native subagent at .claude/agents/<name>.md with name, description and tools frontmatter, using that agent's claude.md as the body minus PAI references.
4. Session protocol: add this section to CLAUDE.md:

   ## Session protocol
   - At start: read docs/context/state.md and docs/context/facts.md before doing anything else.
   - Before finishing any session that changed something: update docs/context/state.md (in progress, next step, blockers) and add durable learnings to docs/context/feedback.md. Replace stale lines rather than appending duplicates.

5. Check `git diff --stat` for anything secret-looking, then commit with a clear message. Do not push.

STEP 3. Report.
Write ~/dev/_migration-report.md: per repo, what moved, what was dropped as PAI-only, open questions, and the branch name. Then give me a short summary.
